_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Orinda Labs corporate site. Change a value HERE, mirror it in the static HTML, then run `python3 scripts/site-check.py` to prove nothing stale survived. The pages are static HTML with no build step, so they cannot import this at runtime — the check script is what keeps them honest.

entity.mailingAddress: 2108 N St, Ste N, Sacramento, CA 95816, USA
entity.footerLine: Orinda Labs LLC is the maker of Raplo Capture.

_inDevelopmentNote: Every name in this list MUST carry a visible 'In development' label wherever it appears on the site, and must never be attached to pricing, signup, or a waitlist. scripts/site-check.py enforces the label.
_domainNote: The site is served on www. The apex forwards to it, because the DNS host offers no ALIAS/ANAME record and DNS forbids a CNAME at the apex. Canonicals therefore name the www host, and they name the extensionless path Azure actually serves — /vision, not /vision.html, which 301s.
